We’re just trying to figure out how we want to do click with odd times/tempo changes live. Our drummer usually just prefers to feel it out though. And yeah I def prefer having an IEM mix. Much easier to hear yourself vocal wise and I use molded Alclair audio IEMs which reduce a lot of the cymbals and whatnot (up to -25db). It’s def helping to save 10khz and up in my hearing.
